monitoring_triggers: Product-level or sufficiently granular non-oncology volume/price/revenue evidence
Verified BMS upfront cash receipt plus R&D/co-development budget or cost allocation
New filing that connects license revenue, performance obligations, R&D and cash flow
Sustained operating free-cash improvement not mainly driven by deposit interest, upfront receipts or one-off working-capital release
Verifiable NewCo valuation/realization/royalty cash flows without double counting
Qualified HiThink market observation; recompute canonical Odds without rewriting frozen Research
open_questions: Non-oncology core product net pricing, persistence and incremental cash contribution
Full R&D/shared costs and taxes of the license-out portfolio
BMS upfront cash receipt, performance budget and retained cash
Net cash at the provisional price date, 2029 net cash and net NewCo equity value
thesis_invalidation: 若连续可比期证明新增非肿瘤产品只有折价/首轮准入造成的收入增长，增量现金贡献无法覆盖存量衰退和必要再投入，且许可全周期剩余现金不能弥补，就应撤销“创新转型能持续增加每股可支配现金”的核心判断。单期GSK确认跨期或单次现金转换下降不构成该证伪。
